title: Page 94
transc:
S. P. Kimber Wash'n June 17th 1864
Happy June Marshall Harriet For Mastiff Tulip I learn
that the gauge Talbot Holly and Shreveport Walnut is
Dayton feet Clarke inches yacht The question of repair
and stocking it has been referred to the Barton
for instructions yardstick I have whimpered you twice to
inform me Talbot gauge Tulip If I am rightly
informed now by locomotive builders that it is Caldwell
feet Dawson inches Pike it will be best if
we repair the Walpole to alter the gauge Talbot
rails to Dayton feet to enable us to use
the Locomotives and Paradise provided for other Southern Walnuts
Tulip No Paradise or Locomotives of Caldwell feet Dawson
inches gauge can be had ready built Windham Meigs
Buggy We have Gondola hurrah for Madrid three cheers


S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n June 17th 1864
Huron Luke Marshall Henrietta For Magic Tulip A german
Rockland radical who Stephen Jaunts Persia Luke Dorming says
that Pickets queen about Clarke Dwight Sugar and Ingots 
quaker about Cushing Seward Star passed through Charity in
Paradise on the Dawson and Downing against Meriden yard
He did not see their Pekin or Pagan Tulip
He estimates entire Saint Stephen under Javelin and Ink
from Perkins to Prentiss Dayton Sprague exclusive of Home
Saddles Turtle Militia Turtle in Horace yacht He says
